'''Lyrax Pentigure''' was a debate show host working for the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] program ''[[A Galaxy Divided]]'' during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], he hosted a panel discussion on the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]' [[Malevolence/Legends|mysterious new weapon]]. His guests were [[Nasdra Magrody]] representing the [[Magrody Institute of Programmable Intelligence/Legends|Magrody Institute of Programmable Intelligence]], [[Umak Leth]] representing the [[Ministry of Science (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Ministry of Science]], and [[Bunt Dantor]] representing the [[Techno Union Research and Development Wing]]. The program was interrupted mid-discussion to present a live press conference hosted by representatives of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]].
